A vast glowing summoning-circle cracking open mid-air, a titanic horned entity dragging itself through the searing rift, energy lashing outward across the scene in arcs of violet fire.
A swirling portal-rift torn through reality itself, edges burning white-hot, an impossible starry void churning within, debris and light spiralling into its maw.
A meteor called screaming down from the heavens in a colossal pillar of fire and smoke, the sky split with red light, the horizon braced for catastrophic impact.
Two arch-wizards locked in thunderous duel, their opposing beams of raw prismatic power colliding in a blinding nexus, the shockwave flattening stone and splitting the earth beneath their feet.

A forbidden necromantic ritual at full roar, a circle of black-flame runes blazing, legions of skeletal dead clawing from churning soil, the sky above darkening with carrion birds and screaming souls.
A city-sized protective ward flaring to sudden blazing life, an immense dome of gold and azure light snapping shut over every tower and rooftop, reality humming and crackling at its boundary.
A storm conjured into a sky-filling vortex of black cloud and green lightning, funnel-winds tearing spires from their foundations, the eye a swirling abyss staring down like a god's furious gaze.
A colossal phoenix rising in a column of white-gold flame, wings spanning the horizon, its cry shattering glass for miles, ash and embers raining upward in spirals against a scorched orange sky.

Time itself fracturing across a spreading crystalline freeze, moments locked mid-motion in luminous amber shards, soldiers and falling towers suspended in silence while the crack races outward with a sound like shattering heaven.

A leyline eruption splitting the ground in a blinding fissure of raw magical light, ancient energies fountaining skyward in cascading arcs, the earth groaning and buckling for miles in every direction.

A colossal rune-array igniting across an entire mountaintop, each carved sigil blazing white-hot in sequence, the pattern completing in a thunderclap of released power that bleaches the clouds and silences every bird.

A soul torn screaming from its vessel, a luminous shrieking shape ripped free by invisible forces, the body crumpling, the soul stretched and writhing as dark tendrils drag it toward a yawning obsidian void.

A titanic earth-elemental conjured from bedrock itself, mountains of stone and magma flowing upward into a heaving colossus, its fists crashing down sending shockwaves rolling across plains like slow, terrible ocean waves.
An ancient sea called into fury by a single spoken word, a wall of water a mile high rising and curling at a sorcerer's gesture, the ocean folding skyward before the devastating crash.

A blood-circle ritual tearing open a planar seal, the boundary between worlds shredding like burning parchment, eldritch geometries spilling through into daylight and the screaming of something vast approaching from the other side.

A thousand war-banners igniting simultaneously as a battle-enchantment detonates, flame roaring across an entire army in disciplined waves of conjured fire, shields glowing red and swords melting in their scabbards.

A dragon-god ancestor summoned from its bone-deep slumber beneath a volcanic peak, the mountain splitting apart as the immense wyrm ascends, magma pouring from its scales, its roar reshaping the clouds overhead.

A sorcerer shattering an entire fortress with one word of unmaking, the walls dissolving outward in a cascade of disintegrating stone, the spell's shockwave visible as a rippling distortion rolling across the countryside.

A celestial conjunction harnessed to fire an arcane lens the size of a cathedral, concentrated moonlight and starfire striking the earth in a column of pure silver brilliance, the ground below turned to glass.

A mirror-maze of conjured illusion expanding to consume an entire valley, dozens of false armies and burning citadels layered over reality, the magic so powerful the illusions begin drawing blood from those they touch.

A death-curse unleashed across a bloodline entire, dark red light racing outward from a speaking sorcerer in branching threads, each thread finding its mark across continents, candles snuffing, hearts stuttering in unison.

An ocean of conjured shadow poured over a capital city, the darkness absolute and alive, writhing with half-formed shapes, the only light the sorcerer's eyes burning at its center like cold white stars.

A mind-shatter spell detonating in a crowded battlefield, a concussive wave of psychic force rolling outward, every combatant within a mile staggering, memories and identities scrambling, some rising hollow-eyed and silent forever after.

A divine invocation answered by a pillar of blinding celestial fire descending from a break in the clouds, the ground sanctified to scorching white stone, the undead within its radius unmade in an instant.

A chain-binding ritual locking a god in place, colossal golden chains erupting from the earth in sequence around an immense divine form, each link blazing with a thousand years of stored mortal prayer and sacrifice.
